assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope.
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered.
The telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion.
The telemetry is ordered to optimize rate control.
The service at issue is CPT 93229.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
